messages:
marta: Heads-up — console team landed a small change to route metadata: we now emit X-Redwood-RouteHash and X-Redwood-Tenant in observability headers. It's intended to help per-tenant quota mapping in dashboards.
jon: Wait, that landed without a compatibility shim? any SDK/edge proxies that parse headers will break.
sima: I saw an error in Go SDK tests this morning — the proxy code assumes route header is a single "route" string, not two headers.
liam: Oof. Which versions are hitting it? prod traffic or just canary?
marta: Mostly canary console telemetry runs, but some staging services pulled the new image and started failing onboarding calls. Not huge, but visible.
jon: We should either revert on console side or add a backwards-compatible header combine in the clients. I prefer a tiny shim in SDKs for patch release.
sima: Agree. Go and TS SDKs are light to update for header parsing. Python also. Patch release seems fastest.
liam: If we do shim in SDKs, we need a clear rule: if X-Redwood-RouteHash present, use it; else fallback to X-Redwood-Route; if both present, we preserve RouteHash for routing and set telemetry route tag to combined value for dashboards.
marta: That mapping makes sense. Console wants routehash isolated so we can fold by tenant in dashboards without leaking route naming.
jon: Two follow-ups: (1) add unit tests for header permutations, (2) add a feature flag in console to not send the new headers until SDK rollout completes.
sima: I'll draft a Go/TS/Py patch today. Proposed header parsing pseudo:```python
route = headers.get("X-Redwood-Route")
route_hash = headers.get("X-Redwood-RouteHash")
tenant = headers.get("X-Redwood-Tenant")
if route_hash:
    routing_key = route_hash
else:
    routing_key = route
telemetry_tag = f"{tenant}:{route or 'unknown'}"```
liam: Nice. Also add telemetry metric for "header_mismatch" so console can alert if both old and new are present in the wild.
marta: We'll add a rollout toggle in console (opt-in per org) and stage the header on 5% then 25% then 100%.
jon: For release notes: call out breaking surface for anyone manually parsing headers in custom proxies. Recommend patching to latest SDK or use the console toggle.
sima: Patch targets: Go v0.9.3-patch1, TS v1.4.2-patch1, Py v0.8.7-patch1. I'll open PRs and link here.
liam: I'll push a small expvar counter to runtime so SRE can track if shims are used.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: console telemetry flag rollout 2026-03-22 21:00 UTC (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%).
marta: Thanks all. Action items: sima PRs for SDK shims, jon add release note blurb, liam add expvar metric, marta gate toggle in console and coordinate rollout.
jon: Keeping thread open until PRs merged. :thumbsup:
